run_load_sharded_state_model: run the vLLM script to load a sharded_state model and generate text completions from a prompt
test_parse_args: test the parse_args function to build CLI argument parser with sharded_state load format defaults
build_engine_args: build EngineArgs from CLI arguments to configure vLLM model loading with tensor parallel size
create_sampling_params: create SamplingParams with temperature, top-p, and max-tokens for controlled text generation
run_llm_generate: run LLM.generate with a prompt and sampling params to produce text completions from the loaded model
